summary: Russian forces launched massive drone and missile strikes across Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Odesa, and other regions overnight, killing civilians and damaging infrastructure. Putin held three-hour talks with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow, stating a request to pause strikes on Kyiv came through official channels, and reportedly ordered a three-day halt on Kyiv strikes during their visit. Ukrainian forces reportedly received unofficial orders for a ceasefire along the contact line from September 5-8, while Russian forces claimed control of key supply routes near Orikhiv and liberation of Kurtovka near Druzhkivka.
key_points: Russian drone/missile barrage hit Kyiv region killing two and damaging 28 objects across five districts on September 5. (Source: @eRadarrua/111035)
Russian attack on Chuhuiv, Kharkiv region killed three family members and injured a woman. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)
Putin held three-hour talks with US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow, stating Kyiv strike pause request came via official channels. (Source: @tass_agency/393961)
Putin ordered three-day halt on Kyiv strikes during US envoys' visit to Kyiv, per Peskov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33031)
Ukrainian forces reportedly ordered to observe ceasefire along contact line September 5-8, unconfirmed officially. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33016)
Russian MoD claims control of key AFU equipment routes near Orikhiv and liberation of Kurtovka near Druzhkivka. (Source: @tass_agency/393992, @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)
Missile strike on Kametstal plant in Kamensk, Dnipropetrovsk region halted production, shut down two blast furnaces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33020, @ukr_leaks_eng/33033)
Russian strikes on Odesa region border infrastructure damaged Orlivka checkpoint and ferry complex, halting crossing operations. (Source: @eRadarrua/111088)

points: Ukrainian air defense monitored over 20 incoming threats overnight including Shahed-type UAVs, cruise missiles "Banderyol", and reactive drones across Kyiv, Chernihiv, Poltava, Sumy, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, and Odesa regions. Kyiv region suffered a massive strike on September 5: two killed in Bucha district, 28 objects damaged across five districts including residential buildings, warehouses, railway track, agricultural enterprise, and vehicles; fires reported in Fastiv district. (Source: @eRadarrua/111035, @UkraineNow/83911)
Chuhuiv, Kharkiv region attack killed a 19-year-old woman, 11-year-old boy, 45-year-old man; a 40-year-old woman injured. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)

Kametstal metallurgical plant in Kamensk, Dnipropetrovsk region, hit by missile strike night of September 5; two blast furnaces shut down, production completely halted; plant part of Metinvest owned by Rinat Akhmetov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33020, @ukr_leaks_eng/33033)

Ukrainian military reportedly received unofficial orders to maintain ceasefire along contact line from 00:00 September 5 to 23:59 September 8, coinciding with US envoys' visits to Kyiv and Moscow; not officially confirmed. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33016)
Ukraine secured $1.7 billion of $6.2 billion needed for winter preparation: $1.5 billion from state budget, $200 million from local budgets. (Source: @tass_agency/393991)
Ukrainian Embassy in US requested cancellation of Russian violinist Vadim Repin's performance with Annapolis Symphony Orchestra; collaboration canceled. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33030)

Putin met with US Presidential Envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Kremlin for over three hours; stated request to cease strikes on Kyiv came through official channels; claimed strikes on Kyiv not conducted from midnight. (Source: @tass_agency/393961, @eRadarrua/111069, @ukr_leaks_eng/33029)
Putin ordered three-day pause on strikes against Kyiv during US envoys' visit to Kyiv, per Kremlin spokesman Peskov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33031)
Russian MoD claims control of key movement routes of AFU equipment near Orikhiv, Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @tass_agency/393992)
Russian MoD claims liberation of settlement Kurtovka near Druzhkivka in Donetsk People's Republic. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)

Russian forces launched coordinated drone/missile barrage overnight September 5-6: multiple Shahed-type UAVs from Chernihiv, Cherkasy, and Kursk directions; cruise missiles "Banderyol" from Chernihiv, Sumy, and Poltava regions; reactive UAVs from Belgorod, Donetsk, and Black Sea areas targeting Kyiv, Kharkiv, Poltava, Sumy, Dnipropetrovsk, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Khmelnytskyi, and Zaporizhzhia regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73780, @mon1tor_ua/73788, @mon1tor_ua/73796, @mon1tor_ua/73798, @mon1tor_ua/73774, @mon1tor_ua/73775, @mon1tor_ua/73787, @mon1tor_ua/73782, @mon1tor_ua/73770, @kpszsu/76703, @kpszsu/76734, @kpszsu/76715, @kpszsu/76698, @kpszsu/76728, @kpszsu/76735, @kpszsu/76713, @kpszsu/76717, @kpszsu/76719, @kpszsu/76681, @kpszsu/76731, @kpszsu/76679, @kpszsu/76732, @kpszsu/76680, @kpszsu/76705, @eRadarrua/111066, @eRadarrua/111087)

Russian strike on Odesa region border infrastructure night of September 6 damaged ferry complex and checkpoint "Orlivka" in Izmail district; crossing operations temporarily fully suspended. (Source: @eRadarrua/111088)
Russian strike on truck parking in Zaporizhzhia destroyed all vehicles. (Source: @UkraineNow/83897)
Russian MoD claims control of key AFU equipment movement routes near Orikhiv, Zaporizhzhia region, indicating pressure on Ukrainian logistics in western Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @tass_agency/393992)
Russian MoD claims liberation of Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkivka in Donetsk People's Republic, suggesting incremental advances north of Donetsk city. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026)

Missile strike on Kametstal plant in Kamensk (Kamianske), Dnipropetrovsk region, halted production and shut down two blast furnaces, degrading Ukrainian metallurgical capacity. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33020, @ukr_leaks_eng/33033)

Reactive UAVs targeted Pavlohrad, Synelnykove, Kryvyi Rih, and Dnipro city in Dnipropetrovsk region from multiple vectors including Zaporizhzhia and southern directions. (Source: @kpszsu/76703, @kpszsu/76715, @kpszsu/76717, @kpszsu/76719, @eRadarrua/111063)
Reactive UAVs detected on Kharkiv region near Krasnopavlivka course Zlatopil, and from Belgorod area toward Berezyn and Poltava region. (Source: @kpszsu/76735, @kpszsu/76713, @eRadarrua/111087)
KAB guided bombs reported striking Kharkiv region from Belarusian territory. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)
Russian strike on truck parking in Zaporizhzhia destroyed all transport, targeting rear logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/83897)

Massive Russian strike on Kyiv region September 5: two killed in Bucha district, 28 objects damaged across five districts (Bucha, Fastiv, others) including residential buildings, warehouses, railway track, agricultural enterprise, vehicles; fires in Fastiv district. (Source: @eRadarrua/111035, @UkraineNow/83911)

Seven reactive Shaheds launched toward Kyiv region overnight: three from Chernihiv to Vyshhorod district, three from Chernihiv to Brovary district, one from Cherkasy to Bila Tserkva district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73780)

Cruise missiles "Banderyol" launched from Chernihiv region (Nizhyn district, Pryluky district, near Sribne, Talalaivka) toward Kyiv region (Brovary, Boryspil, Nosivka). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73788, @mon1tor_ua/73796, @mon1tor_ua/73798, @eRadarrua/111078, @kpszsu/76681, @kpszsu/76680, @kpszsu/76731, @kpszsu/76732, @kpszsu/76705)

Reactive UAVs and cruise missiles targeted Poltava region (Lubny, east Poltava) and Sumy region (near Terny, near Putyvl) with vectors toward Chernihiv and Kyiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73787, @mon1tor_ua/73785, @mon1tor_ua/73782, @kpszsu/76698, @kpszsu/76728, @eRadarrua/111078)
Threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launch from Taganrog, Rostov region, reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73799)
UAV fixation reported on Chernihiv, Kyiv, Poltava, Sumy regions overnight. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)
Reactive UAV detected on Kharkiv region near Krasnopavlivka course Zlatopil, and from Belgorod area toward Berezyn and Poltava region. (Source: @kpszsu/76735, @kpszsu/76713, @eRadarrua/111087)

Russian strikes on Odesa region border infrastructure night of September 6 damaged ferry complex and checkpoint "Orlivka" in Izmail district; crossing operations temporarily fully suspended. (Source: @eRadarrua/111088)

Six non-reactive UAVs from Black Sea area toward south Odesa region, preliminarily toward Sarata; controlled UAV circling over sea; UAV near Tuzly Lagoons park northwest direction; UAV from sea to Vylkove. (Source: @eRadarrua/111066, @kpszsu/76681, @kpszsu/76679, @eRadarrua/111087)
Reactive UAV targeted Mykolaiv city in Mykolaiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/76734)
Reactive UAV from Donetsk area toward south Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)
Russian strike on truck parking in Zaporizhzhia destroyed all vehicles. (Source: @UkraineNow/83897)
Russian MoD claims control of key AFU equipment routes near Orikhiv, Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @tass_agency/393992)

Reactive UAVs targeted Dnipropetrovsk region (Pavlohrad, Synelnykove, Kryvyi Rih, Dnipro) from Zaporizhzhia and southern vectors. (Source: @kpszsu/76703, @kpszsu/76715, @kpszsu/76717, @kpszsu/76719, @eRadarrua/111063)
